hikes.name: South Sister Summit
hikes.blurb: Oregon's third-highest peak on foot: a long, steep cinder climb past Moraine Lake to a crater rim with a snowmelt lake in it.

hikes.name: Green Lakes via Fall Creek
hikes.blurb: Up a waterfall-lined creek beside an obsidian lava flow to turquoise lakes between South Sister and Broken Top.

hikes.name: Broken Top's No Name Lake
hikes.blurb: Across high meadows to a milky lake tucked into Broken Top's crater, with a ridge view over the Three Sisters.

hikes.name: Tam McArthur Rim
hikes.blurb: Up a high, open rim above Three Creek Lake with a long line of Cascade peaks in front of you the whole way.

hikes.name: Moraine Lake
hikes.blurb: The first part of the South Sister climb, to a lake sitting in an old glacial moraine under the summit.

hikes.name: Sisters Mirror Lake and Wickiup Plain
hikes.blurb: Through pumice meadows to a little lake that catches South Sister's reflection.

hikes.name: Tumalo Mountain
hikes.blurb: A short, steep cinder climb to a crater rim facing Mt Bachelor, Broken Top and the Sisters.

hikes.name: Obsidian Trail to Obsidian Falls
hikes.blurb: Over a jagged lava flow and through glittering obsidian fields to a falls below Middle Sister (limited-entry permit).

hikes.name: Proxy Falls Loop
hikes.blurb: A short lava-rock loop to two falls, the lower one a lacy 200-foot spill down a mossy cliff.

hikes.name: Linton Lake
hikes.blurb: Easy forest walk to a lake dammed by lava, with a falls roaring down the far hillside.

hikes.name: Black Crater
hikes.blurb: A steady climb to a craggy summit right across from North Sister and the McKenzie Pass lava fields.

hikes.name: Little Belknap Crater
hikes.blurb: Across raw black lava on the Pacific Crest Trail to a small cone with lava tubes at the top.

hikes.name: North and South Matthieu Lakes
hikes.blurb: Two lakes on the edge of the lava, the upper one in a pass right under North Sister.

hikes.name: Benson Lake
hikes.blurb: A gentle climb to a deep, clear lake ringed by rock, with swimming ponds nearby.

hikes.name: Four-in-One Cone
hikes.blurb: Across open lava and cinder to a row of small craters facing North and Middle Sister.

hikes.name: Tamolitch Blue Pool
hikes.blurb: Along the McKenzie River to where it rises from under a lava flow into an astonishingly blue pool.

hikes.name: Lowder Mountain
hikes.blurb: A climb to a flat summit meadow that ends at a cliff edge high above Karl and Ruth Lakes.

hikes.name: Horse Lake
hikes.blurb: Flat forest miles from Elk Lake to a big lake with a rocky peninsula to explore.

hikes.name: Park Meadow
hikes.blurb: Through dry pine forest to a green meadow with Broken Top and the Sisters lined up behind it.

hikes.name: Camp Lake via Pole Creek
hikes.blurb: A long day into the alpine saddle between North and Middle Sister, ending at a stark lake in the cinders.

hikes.name: Erma Bell Lakes
hikes.blurb: Three swimming lakes and a waterfall between them in the quiet Waldo Lake Wilderness.

hikes.name: Doris Lake
hikes.blurb: An easy climb to a forest lake near Elk Lake, quiet compared with the trails to the north.

hikes.name: Hand Lake
hikes.blurb: A short walk to a meadow lake and an old shelter, with a lava flow and the Sisters beyond.

hikes.name: Lewis Glacier
start: Parking for Hell Creek South Sister Trailhead/Devils Lake
hikes.blurb: From Parking for Hell Creek South Sister Trailhead/Devils Lake, a 10.0-mile round trip to the edge of Lewis Glacier, with about 3,550 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Mount Bachelor
hikes.blurb: From Dutchman Flat Trailhead, a 7.8-mile round trip to the top of Mount Bachelor (9,047 ft), with about 2,800 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Crook Glacier
hikes.blurb: From Broken Top Trailhead, a 4.7-mile round trip to the edge of Crook Glacier, with about 1,450 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Senoj Lake
hikes.blurb: From Six Lakes Trailhead, a 7.8-mile round trip to Senoj Lake, with about 800 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Belknap Crater
hikes.blurb: From McKenzie Pass Trailhead, a 6.5-mile round trip to the top of Belknap Crater (6,828 ft), with about 1,650 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Muskrat Lake
hikes.blurb: From Winopee Lake Trailhead, an 8.6-mile round trip to Muskrat Lake, with about 600 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Kaleetan Butte
start: Parking for Hell Creek South Sister Trailhead/Devils Lake
hikes.blurb: From Parking for Hell Creek South Sister Trailhead/Devils Lake, a 5.8-mile round trip to the top of Kaleetan Butte (6,715 ft), with about 1,600 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Olallie Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Pat Saddle Trailhead, a 7.0-mile round trip to the top of Olallie Mountain (5,665 ft), with about 1,600 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Howlaak Falls
hikes.blurb: From Pole Creek Trailhead, a 7.6-mile round trip to Howlaak Falls, with about 1,250 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Bigelow Hot Spring
hikes.blurb: From McKenzie River Trailhead, a 10.0-mile round trip to Bigelow Hot Spring, with about 1,000 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Macduff Mountain
hikes.blurb: From O'Leary/Castle Rock Trailhead, an 8.8-mile round trip to the top of Macduff Mountain (5,024 ft), with about 3,250 feet of climbing.
